objective: Fix BUKLOD Bahay Kasambahay suggested contacts, name search, invitation status and secure acceptance without changing unrelated rooms or membership roles
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: 2026-11-10 GitHub main baseline f635a7b31d249842add00fa9d1425bb06c76b610 at branch creation. Main is a repository source baseline, not proof of current installed OTA. BUKLOD Connect Supabase yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu has existing invite_v1/decide_v1 and active Bahay memberships; new migration compiled and full invite/search/notification/acceptance/duplicate/authorization flow passed in SQL transaction, rolled back without live schema/data changes. Exact live Android OTA/production fingerprint not established for this PR.
chosenApproach: Bounded server-gated suggestion RPC based on Connect contacts and follower graph; typed name/username search with no private identifier output; user-ID invite RPC guarding active/pending conflicts; preserve old exact username RPC and expiration handling; only small client changes on Bahay People room; no production deployment in this PR.
selectionRationale: Current UI has only exact identifier input and no suggestions. Original backend upsert can reset active members to pending. An additive RPC fixes both while remaining compatible with old clients and protecting private details.
acceptanceChecks: Suggested contacts and typed name/@username matches show as selectable rows, excluding active/pending household members
Home admin only can search, invite and inspect pending list; non-admin rejected by backend
Selected user-ID invite and legacy @username invite produce one pending membership and notification
Double send or re-invite does not reset active membership or duplicate pending notices
Guest invitation expires and cannot be accepted after expiry; eligible re-invite remains possible
Recipient sees invitation on returning to Bahay and can accept/decline in existing UI
Focused Node source contract and rollback-only live Postgres positive and negative auth test pass
No migration activation or OTA/web deploy before exact RC compile, production migration and release verification
preserveBehaviors: Existing Bahay rooms, chores, files, garden, community and notification preferences
Existing admin/owner role boundaries and recipient acceptance choice
Existing RPC for older released clients
regressionTests: Live rollback-only transactional Supabase e2e positive/negative auth test 2026-11-10 (passed)
